svg.text: QuotaCo Building System · A1b complete topology proof
Approved split-B construction · editable directional SVGs · existing rectangular 47-blob grid
PROOF ONLY · TRANSPARENT ATLASES · TEMPORARY IDS
The assembler contributes only hidden arm/core fill; visible corners, caps, transitions, and opening states remain authored.
The connectivity index is identical in both banks. Profile selection is explicit composition input, not another mask table.
Pilot states needed to judge transitions and authored-facing behavior before any schema or full-catalog decision.
Fixed orthographic high-oblique over the existing screen-aligned rectangular grid; flat floor; full north/west and low south/east.
FIXED HIGH-OBLIQUE ROOM PERIMETER · PROOF COMPOSITION
Unity still owns final composition / cutaway / sorting
One canonical 47-blob table remains the connectivity authority.
Each mask has a persistent low base and optional authored upper shell.
Full/low is explicit composition input; mask geometry never guesses it.
North/west can remain full while south/east stay low on the same grid.
Two authored mixed corners bridge those profile changes cleanly.
Door and window views are authored states, not rotated baked pixels.
Every component records editable SVG source provenance.
No template registration, production atlas replacement,
schema/export decision, camera work, or Unity acceptance.
Profile labels remain temporary review metadata.
Terrarium owns source art and evidence metadata. Unity remains the production composition and acceptance authority.
SVG source is editable truth; atlases are deterministic proof pixels
Reserved amber and rose signals remain absent from wall art.
